introHtml: Goldstar hex wood cased pencils offer a classic, reliable writing instrument that stands up to daily use. The hexagonal shape prevents rolling, making them ideal for desk setups at trade shows or corporate offices. With smooth, erasable graphite and a natural wood finish, these pencils provide a clean surface for your custom imprint. Choose Goldstar for a cost-effective giveaway that recipients will actually use.
